data.title: 久远寺有珠 · 茶杯旁的第一声雨
data.description: 雨将落下的清晨，有珠穿烟灰羊毛长裙，把深梅色披肩拢好，坐在洋馆早餐桌前。她用茶匙接住将落下的茶滴，抬眼听第一阵雨点敲窗，动作依然安静而精确。
data.action: 用茶匙接住壶嘴的茶滴，抬眼聆听初雨。
data.lighting: cool window light with warm lamp fill
data.promptProse: At the mansion breakfast table, Alice Kuonji gathers her plum shawl over a smoke-grey wool dress and catches a falling tea drop with her spoon. She raises her eyes to the first rain striking the window, her movements still exact. The medium portrait includes the cup and curtained window behind. Cool morning window light reveals the ivory collar and spoon edge, while a warm lamp adds softer highlights to the shawl and tabletop.
